title: Language modules: resolve source work without hard-coded language guessing
summary: A language-module maps source extensions to source kind, examiner, symbol semantics, optional rule/compile capability and default sphere. Composite source examination resolves this object first.
invariants: The engine does not infer language semantics from generic text search when a language module exists.
A module may describe examination without claiming an editor.
Compiler/runtime validation remains a separate evidence step from lexical source examination.
procedure: Use `gopher language resolve <source>` to identify the module.
Use `gopher language describe <language>` to inspect its declared capabilities.
Use composite `examine source` for source discovery and exact symbol lookup.
Use the module's compile/rule capability when published.
